problem:
$n$ is negative **or** greater than $10,$ **and** $n$ is odd.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $N(n):$ $n$ is negative

- $G(n):$ $n$ is greater than $10,$

- $O(n):$ $n$ is odd
worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧,$" while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨.$"

Note that this sentence consists of two parts: 

- **Part 1:** $n$  is negative or greater than $10.$  This corresponds to

$$
{{n\text{ is negative }}_{⏟}}_{N}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{n\text{ is greater than }10}_{⏟}}_{G},
$$

that is, $N∨G.$

- **Part 2:** $n$ is odd. This corresponds to $O.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{n\text{ is negative }\text{ or }\text{ greater than }10}_{⏟}}_{N∨G}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{n\text{ is odd }}_{⏟}}_{O},
$$

that is, $(N∨G)∧O.$
